name: crew
description: A live panel of the subagents Claude delegates to: model, context, tokens, cost and time, each with an animated mascot.

autoOpen.title: Open automatically
autoOpen.description: Open the panel when Claude first delegates to a subagent (if the terminal is wide enough).

band.title: Band above the prompt
band.description: Show a one-line summary above the prompt while subagents run.

prices.title: Price overrides
prices.description: JSON overriding the price table, $ per million tokens, e.g. {"opus":{"input":4,"output":20,"cacheRead":0.2,"cacheWrite":5}}
